_comment: GEX Gabillon curve engine - all modifiable inputs live here. Edit values, not code.

market_state._note: spot S0 should equal the LCOF short-end (here 690 $/MT, the current green-ammonia level); long_term_anchor is where the curve reverts (450 $/MT as the green premium erodes).

params._note: status drives the provenance banner. lambda_S is the P->Q wedge; 0.0 at inception (no traded risk premium to read it from). Only 'calibrated' params are moved by the optimizer.

calibration._note: LCOF = Levelized Cost Of Fuel curve (power-PPA x efficiency + capex amort + margin), supplied as the fundamental anchor. This is NOT a market futures panel - the engine will label every fit stat as fundamental, never as fit-to-market.

policy_regimes._note: (2) Markov regime switching on L. mu_L is the long-term drift in that state; level_mult_on_entry is a one-off jump to L when the regime is entered (e.g. 45V/RFNBO/IRA erosion lifts the cost floor). Rates are per-year intensities; missing pairs = 0.

manual_branches._note: (3) deterministic committee what-ifs, applied to ALL paths at the given time on top of the regime layer.

hlr_logistics_overlay._note: Henaff-Laachir-Russo storage value repurposed as a LOGISTICS optionality proxy. 'fast' = molecule with available pipeline/shipping (can arbitrage location/time); 'slow' = stranded, thin transport. model_risk_band_pct = +/- band on the value (HLR show ~25% of storage value is pure model choice even with liquid data; we surface it as a band, not a point).

memory._note: calibration with memory: every run is appended here with timestamp/provenance; next run warm-starts its optimizer from the last calibrated params.
